entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I think I need to return something. I'm just not sure how. The website was a bit confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
It's Sarah Gable. The order number is... uh... VF-881-2940-C.

Thank you, Sarah. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Aero Race Jersey, delivered on December 21st. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just the wrong size. I tried it on and it's way too tight. I thought I ordered the right one, but I guess I didn't. I was hoping to do an exchange, but I couldn't figure it out. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Sarah. I understand. Getting the right fit is crucial. Let me just check our return policy for you... one moment.
Okay, I've checked the policy. It looks like you're well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's a relief! So you can just take it back?

Yes, absolutely. I'm generating a prepaid return shipping label for you right now. I'll send it to the email address we have on file. You'll just need to print it, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive the jersey, we'll issue the refund.
Wow, thank you so much, David. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
